definitions.explanation: An aircraft designed to operate from a warship, especially an aircraft carrier.

examples.japanese: {艦載機|かんさいき}が{発進|はっしん}した。
{空母|くうぼ}には{多|おお}くの{艦載機|かんさいき}が{積|つ}まれている。
examples.english: An aircraft carrier holds many carrier-based planes.

examples.japanese: {艦載機|かんさいき}は{短|みじか}い{滑走路|かっそうろ}でも{離着陸|りちゃくりく}できるよう{設計|せっけい}されている。
examples.english: Carrier-based aircraft are designed to take off and land on short runways.

notes:
Compound of {艦|かん} (warship) and {載|さい} (to load, carry) plus {機|き} (aircraft) — literally "ship-loaded aircraft."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {艦載機|かんさいき}の{発着|はっちゃく}: takeoff and landing of carrier aircraft
- {空母|くうぼ}の{艦載機|かんさいき}: an aircraft carrier's planes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦闘機|せんとうき}: fighter jet — defined by its role, not by where it is based
- {空母|くうぼ}: aircraft carrier — the ship that carries them
